presets.coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule (2026-09-26, from LAW-0687/0689-0692; docs/AUTHORING.md item 20). TRUE DRIVER: at 1:1 the context room keeps the floor under the wall unit free for the docked old value and the space beside the unit for the changed-datum marker, the lens needs about 0.37-0.42 of the frame's short side beside the context (which keeps >= 0.46 of the frame width), and the remaining free floor of the room cannot hold four near-maximum participant chips (two of them with 54-character statements) plus two near-maximum exhibit tags. Tried before capping (1:1, text 22.5 down to 16.4 px): right-hand text column at 0.25-0.39 of the width; text band under the room (the lens then has 0.28-0.37 of the short side); room scale 1, 1.25, 1.55; exhibit cabinet on the left wall, bottom wall and right wall; participant chips first or exhibit tags first; five chip widths per participant; a narrower, taller wall display; shortening only the exhibit tags (chip-sp0 still unplaced), only the participant labels (chip-sp0 still unplaced). Rendered numbers (final code, re-measured 2026-09-27 at the hold with production/scratch/hearings-01/capmeasure.mjs, 1080p-normalised) BEFORE the cap: 16:9 20.7 px text / people 66.7 px, 9:16 19.8 px / 82.5 px, 1:1 16.4 px / 68.1 px with participant A's chip and the second exhibit tag unplaced (chip-sp0, chip-ex1 flagged). AFTER the cap (exhibit tags 33/29 characters, statements 34/34): every chip placed — 16:9 20.7 px / 82.1 px, 9:16 19.8 px / 125.7 px, 1:1 16.4 px / 68.1 px. Only the exhibit tags and the two statements are shortened; they stay longer than the baseline (tag 21, statement 29 characters); counts unchanged (4 participants, 2 statements, 2 exhibits); participant labels, before/after values, captions and key keep their near-maximum length. Pre-cap preset kept at production/scratch/hearings-01/LAW-0284.presets.precap.json.
